description: This Java class defines a custom Jackson adapter for the ExternalId type, providing serialization and deserialization logic for proper JSON handling.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter.Serializer

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter.Deserializer
classes.description: Inner class extending JsonDeserializer to deserialize string values into ExternalId objects.
